about_short_description.short_description: Remedial Health is a wholesale company that provides medicines to large and small healthcare industries.

product.name: Remedial Rx
product.description: A software solution to manage daily pharmacy operations, reducing costs and paperwork.

product.name: Remedial Shop
product.description: A digital platform for pharmacies to purchase pharmaceutical stock in one place.

product.name: Remedial Buy Now, Pay Later
product.description: An inventory financing service allowing pharmacies to receive stock immediately and pay later.

product.name: Remedial Benefits Manager
product.description: A service to facilitate delivery of clinical pharmacy services and medications to insurers.

product.name: Remedial Intelligence
product.description: A data analytics service providing insights for the pharmaceutical supply chain.

product.name: Remedial Market Access
product.description: A service helping pharmaceutical manufacturers enter and distribute products in African markets.
